name: Public Landing Page — Prayer Times and Financial Overview

planSteps.description: The page displays the navigation bar with 'Beranda', 'Profil', 'Transparansi', 'Berita & Kegiatan', and 'Kontak'
The prayer times section displays daily prayer intervals including Subuh, Dzuhur, Ashar, Maghrib, and Isya
The financial snapshot card shows the current balance label and a non-empty currency amount
